lines.en: Long legs carry me fast.
I stride over the stubble.
Neck out, eyes sweeping.

lines.zh: 无齿的喙，啄不了硬东西。
lines.en: A toothless beak can't crack much.
The flock's steps are a mess of sound.
I walk and listen.
Long legs lift my view.
Dust rises when I turn.
Running is what I look like.
I weave through scattered trees.
My shadow, thin and long.
I follow wherever the flock goes.
My toes grip well.

lines.zh: 我看一眼左边，再看右边。
lines.en: Left, then right, I check.
I kick the dry twigs aside.
Fast and light, my walk.
Neck stretched, I stand still.

lines.zh: 忽然后退半步，虚惊一场。
lines.en: I startle back a step for nothing.
I preen my chest.
The flock is quiet.
I'm watching the far slope.
The wind chills my neck.
I look up again.
My legs are tired, but I won't sit.
I shake the feathers on my back.
Insects chirp in the grass.
I tilt my head and listen long.
The grass isn't tall enough here.
My long legs shift half a step.
The flock moves; so do I.
Watching me? I won't blink either.
These legs are hard to catch.

lines.zh: 你是站着不动的那种捕食者吗？
lines.en: Are you the kind that stands still?
Raise your hand and the whole flock scatters.
My neck is stretched long.
You have no feathers.
The whole flock is looking.
I shift a step to leave room.

lines.zh: 你的影子太长，让我紧张。
lines.en: Your shadow is long; it makes me tense.
I don't want to be first to run.
See how wide my beak is?
Stand still and I'll dare to look.
The pain makes me cry out.
Something hits my leg; I can't stand straight.
I limp.

lines.zh: 脖子上的羽毛飘下几根。
lines.en: A few neck feathers drift down.
I fall back into the flock.
I can still run with this.

lines.zh: 肋骨在响，呼吸停不下来。
lines.en: My ribs creak and I can't catch my breath.
Not my neck.
I shake my head hard.
My legs shake, but I keep going.
A bug, or fruit?
I approach carefully.
Let go first; then I'll look.
I peck it up and run with it in my beak.
The others are watching it too.
One test bite first.
That smell's a bit off.

lines.zh: 长脖子探过去，又缩回来。
lines.en: My long neck darts out, then pulls back.
Step back and I'll come.
Grab it and run.
You bumped me; I nearly fell.
These thin legs don't take hits.
I hop half a step.
My tail swings and steadies me.
Don't crowd; long legs are unstable.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方草都倒了。
lines.en: The grass lies flat where I've stepped.
I step back to make room.
I bolt right after the bump.
The flock scatters.
That graze doesn't shake my legs.
That one has the longest legs.

lines.zh: 我张开前肢，摆了个姿势。
lines.en: I spread my arms and pose.
We run side by side a while.
She runs faster than I do.
I bring a leaf over.
The nest goes in the earth.
Together, the flock is lively.
She dipped her head at me.
The wind messes our feathers.
Our strides match exactly.
A fruit on the ground.
A flick of my beak and the berry is in my mouth.
That's too small to fill a tooth gap.
I tilt my head and swallow.
Dropped; I peck at it again.
This one takes effort to bite.
I eat while running.
I've got to it first.
One bite, that's all.
That one in the flock is watching.
A shape moved.
I lift my head and look.
Not from our flock.

lines.zh: 两条长腿先绷紧，随时冲。
lines.en: Both long legs tense, ready to bolt.
I call out a warning.
The whole flock looks up.
I've marked that direction.
A little closer and it's too late.
I don't plan to stay.
The wind brings its scent.
It's bigger than us.
If we don't go now, it's too late.

lines.zh: 我挤进群里，让它们先看。
lines.en: I push into the flock and let them look first.
Stop moving and we're done.
I run and glance back.
These long legs earn their keep.
It can't keep up with us.
I break off in another direction.
Our prints give us away.
Don't string the flock out.
My throat is dry from running.
It's still behind.
This slope is too steep.
Into the trees.
I see an opening ahead.

lines.zh: 我数着它的步幅，找缺口。
lines.en: I count its stride, hunting for a gap.

lines.zh: 它脚步散了，我拉开距离。
lines.en: Its steps falter; I open the distance.
It drifts left, so I run right.
We run together.
I lash out with a kick!
My beak can peck too.
I lunge and pull back at once.
That was meant to scare you.
My claws rake the ground.
My wings raise a cloud of dust.
Keep off my neck.
I let out a shrill cry.
If I can't win, I run.
One push of my legs and I'm gone.
These thin legs have little force.
The flock has scattered.
One peck of my beak, then I'm running.
I'm already running.
I run in with the flock.
Long legs land in a puff of dust.
The grass is thin here.
First I raise my neck and listen all around.
A few of us, very noisy.

lines.zh: 我踩着草坡跑下来，扬起土。
lines.en: I run down the grassy slope, kicking up dust.
I call; the flock answers.
My neck reaches high.
Dry ground — good for running.
Shapes in the distance.
I look for the nearest water.
We can stay here a while.
I stand in the middle of the flock.
The dust slowly settles.
I've gathered my strength.
I look at the plains ahead.
My legs already want to run.
The flock has all arrived.
Feathers singe; the smell is sharp.
I land on my legs.
Water over my neck; I can't kick.
The blast throws me into the air.
An arrow grazes my tail feathers; two drift down.
That force makes my legs wobble.
Hunger sets my legs trembling.
A flash, and I drop flat.
No ground; I keep falling.
